entries.question: Is there cosmetic denistry department in kgmu
entries.answer:
KGMU does not have a department explicitly named "Cosmetic Dentistry." However, cosmetic dental procedures are typically managed within the **Department of Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics** and the **Department of Prosthodontics**.

You can find more information about these departments here:
*   [Department of Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=42&dept_type=1)
*   [Department of Prosthodontics](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=44&dept_type=1)

If you are looking for an appointment, please remember that online registration is mandatory. You can book through [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) or by calling 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333.

entries.question: holder jaanch mein Kitna time lagta hai
entries.answer:
Holter monitoring (जिसे आप 'holder jaanch' कह रहे हैं) में आमतौर पर **24 से 48 घंटे** का समय लगता है।

इस जांच के दौरान आपको एक छोटा सा पोर्टेबल डिवाइस पहनना होता है जो आपके दिल की धड़कन (ECG) को लगातार रिकॉर्ड करता है। डिवाइस लगाने के बाद आप अपने सामान्य काम कर सकते हैं, और तय समय (24 या 48 घंटे) पूरा होने के बाद आपको डिवाइस वापस अस्पताल में जमा करना होता है।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **सलाह:** यह जांच कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग (Lari Cardiology) से संबंधित है। कृपया अपनी रिपोर्ट और डॉक्टर की सलाह के लिए सीधे विभाग में संपर्क करें।
* **सावधानी:** मैं एक AI हूँ, डॉक्टर नहीं। यदि आपको सीने में दर्द, सांस लेने में तकलीफ या घबराहट जैसी कोई गंभीर समस्या है, तो कृपया तुरंत KGMU के **ट्रॉमा सेंटर (Gate 14)** या निकटतम आपातकालीन विभाग (Emergency) में जाएं।

अपनी सेहत के बारे में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी या रिपोर्ट यहाँ साझा न करें। कृपया अधिक जानकारी के लिए KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) देखें या कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के PRO कार्यालय से संपर्क करें।

entries.question: For apointment neurology department
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the **Neurology Department** at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online Portal:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) to book your slot.
*   **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or Health Care app to register and book an appointment.
*   **SMS Service:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
*   **Phone:** You can also call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital in person. Please bring the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to the registration counter.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** The registration counters are open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Saturday). 
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book your appointment in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Neurology department.

If you have specific medical symptoms or need a diagnosis, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

**2. Mobile App**

*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same hospital selection flow as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**. 
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Medical Advice:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. If you have specific health concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD.

For further assistance, you can call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
